notes.title: Cowboy 3030 1.0 is Out Now!
notes.content:
Howdy Rangers!

We are excited to announce that Cowboy 3030 has left Early Access into 1.0~!

We want to thank all of our players who have support us on this journey.

Your feedback during EA development has helped shape the game that it is today.

We just want you to know that we appreciate y'all and hope that you enjoyed playing Cowboy 3030 as much as we loved making it.

There is a new playable character that we added for the 1.0 release.

His name is Sam and he's the town doctor. His abilities are scalpel thrower and petri dish poison. 

As always if you have any questions or feedback, we're all ears!

- Soy Boy Devs <3

notes.title: 0.7 - New Boss Update
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

We're excited to announce the release of a brand new Boss Update! This update is a major addition to the Havoc system. Once you've unlocked Havoc, you'll now find an option to change the Boss tier, allowing you to replace existing bosses with new, more challenging adversaries.

Introducing our formidable new bosses: [b]Iron Taurus, Shadow Beak, and Rustlord[/b]. Each one brings a unique challenge designed to test your skills and push your limits.

We can't wait to hear your thoughts on these new bosses! Your feedback and suggestions are invaluable to us, so please don't hesitate to share them.

-Soy Boy Devs

notes.title: 0.6 - The Otto Update (new playable character!)
notes.content:
Howdy folks!

We are excited to add Otto to the Cowboy 3030 roster! Otto is our full-auto specialist who uses a variety of automatic guns ranging from a light machine gun to a FAMAS. His active abilities are the Frost Bomb and Quick Reload. Otto stands out from other characters with his potentially highest DPS, though his bullets are harder to land as you have to lead the shots. He is now available to play in the new 0.6 update!
[previewyoutube=bu5945w3yxc;full][/previewyoutube]
In addition to introducing Otto, we've added weight to all the weapons. You may notice some weapons causing you to move slower or faster depending on their weight.

Please let us know what you think of Otto and any other feedback you have for us!

- Soy Boy Devs

notes.title: Meta Progression Update (0.525)
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are excited to share a major update to the game. We have added a new badge system where you can unlock badges by completing missions. You will be able to equip up to four badges before the start of a run. The badges offer various effects, such as making barrels spawn coins, causing bosses and mini-bosses to drop an extra weapon, allowing you to reroll your progression grid, and more. Currently, there are 12 badges to unlock, and we plan to add more throughout development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43768624/17bf9908cfbf756fc83df462747c3960d3d15a4c.jpg[/img]

We appreciate everyone for playing the game and providing valuable feedback. Our goal is to create the best game possible for our players, and the number one request we received was to add meta-progression. Therefore, we created the badge system, which offers a mix of light stat boosts and QoL enhancements. Our intention with the new badge system is to give players a sense of progress without altering the core gameplay too much.

We hope you enjoy the new system! If you have any suggestions or feedback, we are all ears and would love to hear from you!

Additionally, thank you to our supportive community for leaving reviews. We are thrilled to have achieved the 'Very Positive' rating milestone with 52 reviews, 98% of which are positive!

Thank you all for your support!

Additional bug fixes and updates:
[list]
[*] Fixed hoarder achievement
[*] Nerfed slug shotgun
[*] Decreased Teri's max hp by 25
[*] Weakened Teri's and Keri's weapon scaling
[*] Nerfed additional pellet upgrade
[*] Fixed missing hitboxes in some rooms
[*] Increased health of bosses
[*] Death count and gold count of teammates are now visible
[*] Fixed glitch causing UI info screens to stay on during death and teleportation
[/list]

notes.title: Cowboy 3030 is out now!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2347550/Cowboy_3030/]Cowboy 3030 is now available[/url] to purchase for $14.99 with a 20% launch discount during the first week!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43768624/148890e392f067af19bc946b16f06f5a4f080d35.jpg[/img]

[h3]Here are all the fun content you can explore either in single-player or with friends in 2-4 player online co-op![/h3]
[list]
[*] 3 playable characters, each with unique abilities, personalized upgrades, and distinct weapon selection
[*] 3 levels, paired with original soundtrack composed by [url=https://twitter.com/JamesElseyMusic]James Elsey[/url]
[*] Over 50 unique enemies including 3 main bosses, 9 mini bosses, and over 40 different minions
[*] 5 levels of Ascension you can unlock 
[/list]
[h3]This is only the beginning for Cowboy 3030 as we plan to roll out new content throughout Early Access development which include:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Local co-op
[*] New playable characters
[*] New weapons and buffs for each character
[*] New bosses and enemies
[*] New Ascension modes
[*] and more!
[/list]
In addition to new content, we will continue to make improvements and fixes to the game weekly. If you experience any issues or bugs, please reach out to us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/HTBQwWF65A]our Discord[/url] or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2347550/discussions/]Community Hub[/url] so that we can resolve it as soon as possible. Your feedback is very valuable to us and we'd love to hear your thoughts and feedback on the game.

[h3]Thank you everyone for your support and we hope you enjoy the game![/h3]

- Soy Boy Devs

notes.title: What's coming to Early Access!
notes.content:
Howdy everyone!

We are just weeks away from our Steam Early Access launch on May 28th! 

We would like to take the opportunity to share with our Steam community all the new content and features you will see in the Early Access version of the game that's different from the demo!

We also regularly share updates in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/HTBQwWF65A]Discord[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/soyboygames]Twitter[/url] so feel free to follow and join us on those platforms as well!

[h2]Updated artstyle[/h2]
We improved the overall visual artstyle of the game with a new shader. This improvement was also reflected in the most recent demo update so feel free to check it out and let us know your thoughts in the comments!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43768624/3e4eeae87b0b1a9f425c17a615a66139a00a666d.jpg[/img]

[h2]New playable character[/h2]
If you've played the demo, then you're already familiar with Keri and Calix.
We are introducing a new character to the line up - Teri, Keri's older brother!
Teri is our shotgun specialist and his abilities include the spread projector, magnetic grappler and electric shock. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43768624/54ce05ab5a627bf74ca39de2774891fbcbfb7283.gif[/img]

[h2]New biomes and new enemies![/h2]
We've added 2 new biomes, and a TON of new enemies and bosses!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43768624/3b06e383971f29fca146c3f0af039106cd0f6731.gif[/img]

[h2]New weapon drops with modifiers[/h2]
We've implemented a new weapon drop system where weapons will randomly drop after killing an enemy and stronger weapons will drop after killing a mini boss. Each weapon will have different modifiers as well. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43768624/cada5988417b092c5ad0b3bd5b18f8e58b210663.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Shop features[/h2]
We've added 2 new features to the shop: 
- Swap out special upgrades on your progression grid
- Level up your boosters at the booster upgrade machine
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43768624/f90ebb85c64080e773fc0c68241a4d9a8f0f60e9.gif[/img]

We have a few more features that will be coming to Early Access that we won't reveal just yet!
Don't forget to mark your calendars for May 28th!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2347550/Cowboy_3030/
